title: Updating the middle coordinate
statement: For natural numbers $p,c,a,q$, let $r:\{0,1,2\}\to\mathbb{N}$ be given by $r(0)=p$, $r(1)=c$, and $r(2)=a$. Replacing $r(1)$ by $q$ gives the function whose values at $0,1,2$ are respectively $p,q,a$.
